blocks.text: Yeh Unit 9 (Division of Polynomials) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a polynomial in \(x\) and its degree. Give the degree of \(7x^{4} - x + 2\).
(\(x\) mein polynomial aur us ki degree ki definition likhein. \(7x^{4} - x + 2\) ki degree batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Polynomial \(a_{n}x^{n} + a_{n-1}x^{n-1} + \ldots + a_{1}x + a_{0}\) hai jahan \(n\) non-negative integer aur coefficients real numbers hain. \(x\) ki sab se bari power degree hai. \(7x^{4} - x + 2\) ki degree 4.

book_ref.quote: is called the degree of the polynomial

blocks.prompt:
2 Divide \(2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + x + 5\) by \(x - 2\) and write the quotient and remainder.
(\(2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + x + 5\) ko \(x - 2\) se taqseem kar ke quotient aur remainder likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Quotient \(2x^{2} + x + 3\), remainder \(11\); tasdeeq: \((x - 2)(2x^{2} + x + 3) + 11\) dividend deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
3 Find the quotient and remainder when \(2x^{3} - x^{2} + 4x + 1\) is divided by \(x^{2} + 2\).
(\(2x^{3} - x^{2} + 4x + 1\) ko \(x^{2} + 2\) se taqseem karne par quotient aur remainder nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(2x\), baqi \(-x^{2} + 1\); phir \(-1\), baqi \(3\). Quotient \(2x - 1\), remainder \(3\).

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
4 A polynomial \(f(x)\) divided by \(x - 3\) gives quotient \(2x + 1\) and remainder \(-4\). Find \(f(x)\).
(\(f(x)\) ko \(x - 3\) se taqseem karne par quotient \(2x + 1\) aur remainder \(-4\) hai. \(f(x)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Dividend = Divisor \(\times\) Quotient + Remainder: \(f(x) = 2x^{2} - 5x - 7\).

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
5 When do we stop dividing one polynomial by another? What is the greatest possible degree of the remainder when the divisor is quadratic?
(Aik polynomial ko doosre se taqseem karna kab rokte hain? Quadratic divisor ho to remainder ki zyada se zyada degree kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Jab remainder ki degree divisor ki degree se kam ho jaye to rok dete hain. Quadratic divisor par remainder ki degree zyada se zyada 1 (linear ya constant).

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
6 State the remainder theorem.
(Remainder theorem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar degree \(n \ge 1\) wale polynomial \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se itna taqseem karein ke remainder mein \(x\) wali term na rahe, to remainder \(f(a)\) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
7 Prove the remainder theorem.
(Remainder theorem saabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x) + R\); \(x = a\) rakhne se \(f(a) = (a - a)q(a) + R = R\). Is liye remainder \(= f(a)\).

book_ref.quote: Hence remainder \(= f(a)\).

blocks.prompt:
8 Without dividing, find the remainder when \(2x^{3} + 3x^{2} - x + 4\) is divided by \(x - 2\).
(Taqseem kiye baghair \(2x^{3} + 3x^{2} - x + 4\) ko \(x - 2\) se taqseem karne ka remainder nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the remainder when \(x^{4} - 2x^{3} + x - 5\) is divided by \(x + 2\).
(\(x^{4} - 2x^{3} + x - 5\) ko \(x + 2\) se taqseem karne ka remainder nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
10 Find \(k\) if \(2x^{3} - kx^{2} + 3x + 1\) leaves remainder 7 when divided by \(x - 1\).
(\(k\) nikalein agar \(2x^{3} - kx^{2} + 3x + 1\) ko \(x - 1\) se taqseem karne par remainder 7 ho.)

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
11 Find \(k\) if \(x^{4} + kx^{3} - 2\) leaves remainder \(-3\) when divided by \(x + 1\).
(\(k\) nikalein agar \(x^{4} + kx^{3} - 2\) ko \(x + 1\) se taqseem karne par remainder \(-3\) ho.)

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the remainder when \(x^{3} + 4x^{2} - 3\) is divided by \(x + 3\).
(\(x^{3} + 4x^{2} - 3\) ko \(x + 3\) se taqseem karne ka remainder nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
13 State the factor theorem.
(Factor theorem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x - a\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai agar aur sirf agar \(f(a) = 0\); yani \(x = a\) equation \(f(x) = 0\) ka root ho.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
14 Prove the factor theorem.
(Factor theorem saabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x) + R\), \(R = f(a)\). Agar \(f(a) = 0\) to \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x)\): factor. Ulta, agar \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x)\) to \(f(a) = 0\).

book_ref.quote: which proves the theorem.

blocks.prompt:
15 Show that \(x + 3\) is a factor of \(x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 5x - 6\).
(Dikhayein ke \(x + 3\), \(x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 5x - 6\) ka factor hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-3) = -27 + 18 + 15 - 6 = 0\); factor theorem se \(x + 3\) factor hai.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.explanation: \(f(2) = -1 \ne 0\), is liye \(x - 2\) factor nahin.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
17 Find \(k\) if \(x + 2\) is a factor of \(x^{3} - kx + 4\).
(\(k\) nikalein agar \(x + 2\), \(x^{3} - kx + 4\) ka factor ho.)

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
18 If \(x - 1\) and \(x + 2\) are factors of \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 6\), find \(p\) and \(q\).
(Agar \(x - 1\) aur \(x + 2\), \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 6\) ke factors hon to \(p\) aur \(q\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(1) = 0\) aur \(f(-2) = 0\) rakh kar do equations hal karein.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
19 Show that \(x - 1\) is a factor of \(x^{n} - 1\) for every positive integer \(n\).
(Dikhayein ke har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(x - 1\), \(x^{n} - 1\) ka factor hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(1) = 1^{n} - 1 = 0\); factor theorem se \(x - 1\) factor hai.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
20 Show that \(x - 2\) and \(x - 3\) are factors of \(x^{3} - 4x^{2} + x + 6\).
(Dikhayein ke \(x - 2\) aur \(x - 3\), \(x^{3} - 4x^{2} + x + 6\) ke factors hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(2) = 0\) aur \(f(3) = 0\); factor theorem se dono factors hain.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
21 What is synthetic division? For which divisors can it be used?
(Synthetic division kya hai? Yeh kin divisors ke liye istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synthetic division \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) qisam ke polynomial se taqseem karne ka mukhtasar tareeqa hai. Sirf coefficients likhte hain; vertical pattern: jama, diagonal pattern: \(a\) se zarb.

book_ref.quote: This process of division is called Synthetic Division.

blocks.prompt:
22 Use synthetic division to divide \(x^{3} - 4x^{2} + 2x + 3\) by \(x - 3\).
(Synthetic division se \(x^{3} - 4x^{2} + 2x + 3\) ko \(x - 3\) se taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = 3\): teesri line \(1, -1, -1, 0\). Quotient \(x^{2} - x - 1\), remainder 0.

book_ref.quote: Write down the coefficients of the dividend

blocks.prompt:
23 Use synthetic division to find the quotient and remainder when \(2x^{4} - x^{3} + 3x - 4\) is divided by \(x + 1\).
(Synthetic division se \(2x^{4} - x^{3} + 3x - 4\) ko \(x + 1\) se taqseem karne par quotient aur remainder nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = -1\), missing \(x^{2}\) ke liye 0; teesri line \(2, -3, 3, 0, -4\). Quotient \(2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + 3x\), remainder \(-4\).

book_ref.quote: Insert 0 for any missing term.

blocks.prompt:
24 Divide \(x^{3} + 8\) by \(x + 2\) using synthetic division.
(Synthetic division se \(x^{3} + 8\) ko \(x + 2\) se taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = -2\); teesri line \(1, -2, 4, 0\): quotient \(x^{2} - 2x + 4\), remainder 0.

book_ref.quote: Insert 0 for any missing term.

blocks.prompt:
25 Use synthetic division to show that \(x = 3\) is a zero of \(x^{3} - 2x^{2} - 5x + 6\), and factorize it completely.
(Synthetic division se dikhayein ke \(x = 3\), \(x^{3} - 2x^{2} - 5x + 6\) ka zero hai, aur isay poori tarah factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x - 3\) se taqseem; remainder zero ho to \(x = 3\) zero hai; phir quotient factorize karein.

book_ref.quote: Write down the coefficients of the dividend

blocks.prompt:
26 Use synthetic division to divide \(3x^{3} - 2x + 5\) by \(x - 2\).
(Synthetic division se \(3x^{3} - 2x + 5\) ko \(x - 2\) se taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = 2\), missing \(x^{2}\) ke liye 0; teesri line \(3, 6, 10, 25\). Quotient \(3x^{2} + 6x + 10\), remainder 25.

book_ref.quote: Insert 0 for any missing term.

blocks.prompt:
27 Using synthetic division, find \(k\) so that \(x - 2\) is a factor of \(x^{3} - 3x^{2} + kx - 2\).
(Synthetic division se \(k\) nikalein taake \(x - 2\), \(x^{3} - 3x^{2} + kx - 2\) ka factor ho.)
blocks.explanation: Teesri line \(1, -1, k - 2, 2k - 6\); remainder \(2k - 6 = 0\), \(k = 3\).

book_ref.quote: Use the following patterns to write the second and third lines:

blocks.prompt:
28 What is polynomial regression and when is it used?
(Polynomial regression kya hai aur kab istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh regression analysis ki qisam hai jis mein independent aur dependent variables ka taaluq \(n^{\text{th}}\)-degree polynomial se zahir kiya jata hai. Jab data ka taaluq curved (non-linear) ho aur hamwar continuous function chahiye ho to istemal hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
29 A model \(P(x) = x^{3} - x + 10\) is fitted to monthly data. If the observed value in month 4 is 75, find the percentage error.
(Mahana data par model \(P(x) = x^{3} - x + 10\) fit kiya gaya. Agar 4th mahine ki observed qeemat 75 ho to percentage error nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Remainder theorem se predicted \(P(4)\), phir Error = Observed \(-\) Predicted, phir observed ke hisaab se percentage.

blocks.prompt:
30 What is digital signal processing, and how is the remainder theorem used in it?
(Digital signal processing kya hai aur is mein remainder theorem kaise istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: DSP computers ya digital devices mein awaaz, tasaveer ya sensor data jaise signals ko jaanchne, badalne ya behtar banane ke liye istemal hoti hai. Remainder theorem system response ki qeemat nikalna aasan banata hai; remainder zero ho to us input par koi error nahin.

book_ref.quote: The remainder theorem is a powerful mathematical tool in DSP

blocks.prompt:
31 A system is represented by \(P(z) = z^{3} + 2z^{2} - z - 2\). Find its response at \(z = 1\) and state what it shows.
(System \(P(z) = z^{3} + 2z^{2} - z - 2\) ka \(z = 1\) par response nikalein aur batayein is se kya pata chalta hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(P(1) = 0\): remainder zero, \(z = 1\) par koi error nahin, aur \(z - 1\) factor hai.

book_ref.quote: If the remainder is zero, it means that the system has no error at that input.

(Quadratic model \(P(x) = x^{2} + bx - 10\) ke liye \(P(5) = 0\) hai. \(b\) nikalein.)

blocks.prompt:
33 A signal is represented by \(S(t) = 2t^{2} - 3t + 1\). Using the remainder theorem, find the remainder when the input is \(t = 3\).
(Signal \(S(t) = 2t^{2} - 3t + 1\) hai. Remainder theorem se input \(t = 3\) par remainder nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The remainder theorem is a powerful mathematical tool in DSP

blocks.prompt:
34 A data set is modelled by \(P(x) = x^{3} - 4x^{2} + 2x + 3\). Does the point \(x = 3\) give a zero of the model?
(Data set ka model \(P(x) = x^{3} - 4x^{2} + 2x + 3\) hai. Kya \(x = 3\) model ka zero hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(P(3) = 0\), haan: \(x = 3\) zero hai aur \(x - 3\) factor hai.
